subject: Two-day virtual onsite: sequencing & slot adjustments for Senior Infra Eng
messages:
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@example.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed two-day virtual onsite (May 18-19) — Senior Infra Eng

Hi Ava —

Thanks again for taking the process forward. We’d like to run a compact two-day virtual onsite aimed at keeping mornings focused and preserving one afternoon slot for a deep system design / hands-on exercise. Below is a draft sequence — please let us know whether May 18–19 still works and which of the suggested windows suit you.

Day 1 (May 18)
- 10:00–10:45 PT: culture + kickoff / hiring manager (Marissa & Laura) — quick context and product Qs
- 11:00–12:00 PT: systems design (Jordan) — whiteboard via Miro
- 13:00–14:00 PT: lunch break (candidate time)
- 14:30–15:30 PT: scoped debugging exercise (pairing) — hands-on

Day 2 (May 19)
- 09:30–10:15 PT: local infra deep dive (Irene)
- 10:30–11:15 PT: cross-functional partner panel (engineering + PM)
- 11:30–12:00 PT: debrief / next steps with recruiter (Marissa)

Attachments: Agenda_v1.pdf (draft).

A couple of asks: if any slot timing conflicts with your schedule, suggest an alternate window on the same day; we’d prefer to keep the systems design on Day 1 morning if possible to reduce context switching. Also please confirm whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@example.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed two-day virtual onsite (May 18-19) — Senior Infra Eng

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — May 18–19 works generally. Quick note: I have a standing call on May 18 from 14:00–15:00 PT; could we move the Day 1 afternoon exercise 15:00–16:00 PT instead? Also Google Meet is preferred.

Happy to confirm once you send the updated times.

Thanks,
Ava
Ava Thompson
ava.thompson@example.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@example.com>, Tier1 Talent <lauren@tier1talent.co>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposed two-day virtual onsite — candidate asks to shift Day 1 exercise 1 hour later

Folks —

Ava can do May 18–19 but needs the Day 1 afternoon exercise moved to 15:00–16:00 PT. I updated the agenda (Agenda_v2.pdf attached) to reflect:

Day 1 (May 18)
- 10:00–10:45 PT: culture + kickoff (Laura + me)
- 11:00–12:00 PT: systems design (Jordan)
- 13:00–14:00 PT: lunch
- 15:00–16:00 PT: debugging exercise (pairing) — moved by request

Day 2 (May 19) — unchanged except final debrief left at 11:30–12:00.

Quick asks for the interviewers:
- Jordan: can you confirm you’re ok to lead systems design at 11:00? If you’d prefer design after lunch (to give the candidate time to warm up) I can propose swapping your slot with Irene but we’d like the design before the pairing exercise.
- Irene: can you confirm 09:30–10:15 on Day 2 is still fine for the infra deep dive?
- Laura: please confirm you and I will split kickoff time and handle culture questions in the 10:00 slot.

If everyone confirms I’ll send calendar invites and the calendar .ics.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@example.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed two-day virtual onsite — candidate asks to shift Day 1 exercise 1 hour later

Sounds good — I confirm 11:00–12:00 PT on Day 1 for systems design and I’m fine keeping it before the pairing exercise. I’ll prepare a focused 45-min prompt with one followup scenario so the panel has clear scoring anchors.

Quick note for sequencing: please keep the debrief order as candidate -> interviewing panel -> hiring manager, so the pairing facilitators (Jordan) provide immediate notes before the sync with hiring.

Thanks — I’m good to go.
Jordan Blake
Staff Engineer, Redwood Inference

On 2027-05-09 11:20, marissa_cole@redwood.com wrote:
> Folks —
> 
> Ava can do May 18–19 but needs the Day 1 afternoon exercise moved to 15:00–16:00 PT. I updated the agenda (Agenda_v2.pdf attached) to reflect...

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@example.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-10T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: May 18–19 virtual onsite + calendar invites

Hi Ava —

Great — everything is confirmed. Calendar invites and Google Meet links attached (CalendarInvite.ics). Final agenda is attached (Agenda_v2.pdf). Highlights / logistics:
- Please join the Day 1 kickoff at 10:00 PT (Google Meet).
- Systems design with Jordan at 11:00 PT (Miro link in invite).
- Pairing exercise moved to 15:00–16:00 PT Day 1 as requested — we’ll share the repo snippet ahead of time.
- Day 2 infra deep dive with Irene at 09:30 PT, partner panel at 10:30, final debrief at 11:30.

For interviewers — quick checklist:
- Join 10 mins early to load the Miro board and test screenshare.
- Use the scorecard in the drive doc linked in the invite — we’ll consolidate notes immediately after each slot.

Ava, feel free to reply here if any last-minute issues. Jordan / Irene / Laura — thank you for confirming. I’ll send the candidate prep doc and pairing repo link separately.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Agenda_v2.pdf, CalendarInvite.ics
